acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Orcs family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Overlord, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Trial-of-Standards Tyrant (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Near-giant, with dagger-long tusks, armor forged from a great beast's ribcage, a cloak of layered hides, and a banner-pole carrying multiple enemy standards whose removable ribs extend the silhouette into arena gates.

Signature mechanic: Trial of Standards: the Overlord plants three enemy standards around a central ribcage throne and impales one with its banner-pole to begin a trial. The Rush standard sends Grunts through narrow shoulder lanes and promotes a survivor into a Warrior; the Red standard pairs Warriors into crossing breaches and marks a survivor as a Berserker; the Skull standard lets a Warchief rotate every remaining lane. Breaking a standard permanently removes that trial. After each break, the Overlord tears one rib plate from its great-beast armor to wield as a curved arena gate, changing the remaining routes rather than simply gaining power.
battlefieldDuty: Command a phased arena trial in which captured standards define challenge lanes, surviving lower forms earn transformations into the next duty, and the Overlord personally enforces whichever standard remains standing.
constructionDimensions: Armor and weapons become a heavy hydraulic raid kit of waterlogged hide, ship-chain, hammered cistern plates, horn valves, pressure bladders, and axe channels riveted onto ordinary Orc equipment.
Surface and attack motion track stored pressure through darkened fur, wet iron reflections, swelling rawhide reservoirs, coherent weapon-edge jets, and runoff that follows the committed swing.
counterplay: Read the selected standard, defeat or displace its designated survivor before promotion, attack the standard during the Overlord's committed enforcement sweep, and use each removed rib gate to block the next trial lane; destroying all standards ends promotions and forces a direct final duel with permanently opened armor seams. Affinity signal: A rawhide bladder swells and its bone valve chatters before pressure drives the strike; opening the valve or puncturing the marked seam drains the attack and unbalances the loaded weapon.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only water treatment without reservoirs, wet materials, and pressure-driven motion
Glow-only water treatment without coherent flow paths or hydraulic equipment
Shapeless water anatomy that replaces Orc mass, skin, tusks, or armor
Spray dense enough to hide war paint, weapon arcs, or valve counterplay
identityInvariants: Tall, broad, top-heavy humanoid silhouette with a thick neck, wide shoulders, heavy jaw, forward lean, and lower tusks rising past the lip.
Grey-green or ash-grey skin is framed by blood red, black, dark iron, bone white, and readable red or white war paint.
Boiled leather, fur, riveted iron, bone, and crude steel remain thick, weighty, and practical rather than elegant or finely matched.
Scars, paint, tusk rings, piercings, skull trophies, spiked pauldrons, and clan totems communicate earned encounter rank without becoming a biological claim.
Tusk length, muscle mass, posture, and carried trophies escalate together, but every form retains committed heavy motion and exposed recovery as the family combat grammar.
telegraph: The dagger-long tusks hook a chosen standard, the cloak of hides swings toward its painted lane, and the matching lower forms strike weapons or scars in unison while one rib plate visibly unlocks from the armor.
